Album Cover Similarity Analysis

Interactive visual comparison tool across 1,000+ pop and rock albums

How Similarity Is Measured

Every album cover is compared across two visual dimensions:

  1. Color Palette: Compares dominant RGB hues, saturation (vibrancy), and color tone.
  2. Design & Composition: Compares overall brightness balance and grayscale visual contrast.

Scores range from 0% (completely opposite visual styles) to 100% (virtually identical color & layout).
